name: a closed shop diorama holds in the evening light
looks: A small isometric 3D diorama of a shopfront floats on a round platform, lit warm and dim, trees and a bench drifting faintly for parallax. A caption states the time and that the shop is closed, over the still scene.
build: cinematic-atmosphere-hold: a near-static camera on the diorama, two or three background layers (trees, lamp, signage) drifting at slightly different speeds for parallax, a warm low-key grade with a soft vignette.
sound: A low ambient pad, quiet street-at-night room tone.
prompt: Hold a small diorama-style 3D scene of a place that is closed or off-duty, lit warm and dim with faint parallax drift in the background layers. Caption it with the time and the fact that it is closed, to set up a problem the product will solve.
